name: agent-skills-kit
description: Agent skills for workspace setup, discovery, building, verifying, and shipping.

plugins.name: workspace-setup
plugins.description: Set up a workspace and find your way around the kit: generated agent instructions, a skill router, and the kit's own authoring style.

plugins.name: discover-plan
plugins.description: Understand existing behaviour and shape the work before building: read-only discovery, feature prompts, port gap maps, and cross-project contracts.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: Build the work: a test-first loop, worktree setup, and fan-out of a spec's issues to herdr tabs or T3 Code threads.

plugins.name: visual-design
plugins.description: Build and verify UI against a design source: design-system setup, per-page pixel audit, and the cosmetic polish tail.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Ship issue work: commit and close, commit and open a PR, work through reviewer feedback, and write release notes.

plugins.name: staging-promotion
plugins.description: Move work through staging: promote local to staging, fix a staging bug through a PR, and check readiness for the owner's production promotion.

plugins.name: factory-workflow
plugins.description: Factory workflow skills: a conductor that reads where work stands and names the next gate, plus CI repair, agentic QA, risk-gated review, staging deploy watch, QA-escape intake, QA issue reporting, and incident triage.
